name: prometheus-web-obfuscator
description: Interface Web para Prometheus Lua Obfuscator

scripts.build: apt-get update && apt-get install -y lua5.1 && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prometheus-lua/Prometheus/master/install.sh | sh && cp -L ~/.local/bin/prometheus-lua ./prometheus-cli && chmod +x ./prometheus-cli
